card.name: Digits and units inside numeric tables
card.fires_on: Marked words inside numbers, ranges and measurement tables, such as a digit partway through a figure, a space or unit letter after a number, or a bracket after a quantity. Also some small words in clauses about age or size.

modes.label: Digits in tables
modes.description: A single digit or number piece inside a table of results or doses.

modes.label: Units and brackets after numbers
modes.description: A space, unit letter or opening bracket right after a measurement.

modes.label: Small words near ages or limits
modes.description: A small word such as the or it in a clause that states an age or a limit.

card.writes: It slightly promotes words about duration and periods and suppresses words about sides and space, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on numbers and units in tables and ranges, not on any one medical idea.
